  • SSH and Jupyter

    Add your SSH key, pick a GPU, and connect. Every instance also serves Jupyter for notebooks.

  • Billed per second

    Pay only for the seconds it runs, in Texel credits. No contract and no minimum term.

  • Nothing for a busy GPU

    A GPU that is busy when you rent it charges nothing. Pick another, or rent the cheapest available one.

  • A disk for the rental

    The disk of an instance ends with the rental, so keep your data elsewhere.
